summary: FS and rec.gov current. 26 sites (21 reservable, 5 first-come), $20.50 on rec.gov ($23 on FS), extra vehicle $9, 14-day limit, 2027 season Jun 11 - Sep 20. Count 27 -> 26 (no site 014). Not waterfront stands, with a creekside lead at site 018. Phone empty -> (307) 431-7446.
flags: FEE CONTRADICTION: FS page 'Single Site: $23 per night' vs rec.gov $20.50 (2026-2028 seasons). Written rec.gov's $20.50 per the lesson; FS figure flagged.
SEASON: rec.gov's 2027 season is Jun 11 - Sep 20; FS says 'Memorial Day - Labor Day, weather dependent'. Written rec.gov.

WATERFRONT (checked): 'not waterfront' stands. The South Tongue River beside the east loop is ~11-16 m wide on imagery (creek-size, so any on-water value would be creekside). Nearest site 018 (44.71529,-107.44912, reservable, sold nightly) is ~34 m from the west bank across a meadow, with a fence line and a few scattered conifers between - a creekside LEAD for the reviewer, one site only. Sites 022 (44.71556,-107.44896) and 023 (44.71578,-107.44889) are ~55-60 m from the water over open meadow; the rest are in the trees 100 m+ away. No upgrade proposed (default down). rec.gov markets it as 'on the banks of the South Tongue River'.
PHONE: empty -> (307) 431-7446 (concessionaire line on rec.gov, same as Sibley Lake / Sitting Bull). FS district office is (307) 674-2600.
SITES: stored count 27 -> 26 (catalog numbers 001-027 but has no 014).
OHV: FS lists 'OHV Trail Riding' among nearby recreation; a general campground, not a staging area - flag only.
